questions.problem:
Consider the Poisson distribution $\text{Po}(11).$ Rounding to $4$ decimal digits, fill in the missing value in the corresponding table for the cumulative distribution function below.

| $\,x\,$ | $6$ | $7$ | $8$ | $9$ | $10$ | $11$ | $12$ |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| $P(X\le x)$ | $\,0.0786\,$ | $\,0.1432\,$ | $\,0.2320\,$ | $\,0.3405\,$ | {{field-1}} | $\,0.5793\,$ | $\,0.6887\,$ |
questions.worked_solution:
The cumulative distribution function of a discrete random variable $X$ is a function $F(x)$ such that

$$
F(x)=P(X\le x).
$$

The probability mass function for the Poisson distribution $\text{Po}(\lambda )$ is given by

$$
f(x)=\frac{{\lambda }^{x}{e}^{-\lambda }}{x!},\,x=0,1,2,3,…\,.
$$

In our case, $\lambda =11.$ 

Therefore, we compute the missing element of the table as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}F(10) & =P(X\le 10) \\  & =P(X\le 9)+P(X=10) \\  & =F(9)+P(X=10) \\  & =0.3405+\frac{{11}^{10}\cdot {e}^{-11}}{10!} \\  & ≈0.4599\end{aligned}
$$

fields.input_html: 0.4599

The cumulative distribution function of a discrete random variable $X$ is a function $F(x)$ such that

$$
F(x)=P(X\le x).
$$

So, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}F(9) & =P(X\le 9) \\  & =P(X\in \{0,1,…,9\}) \\  & =P(X\in \{0,1,…,8\})+P(X=9) \\  & =P(X\le 8)+P(X=9) \\  & =F(8)+P(X=9).\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}P(X=9) & =F(9)-F(8) \\  & =0.0699-0.0374 \\  & =0.0325.\end{aligned}
$$

The cumulative distribution function of a discrete random variable $X$ is a function $F(x)$ such that

$$
F(x)=P(X\le x).
$$

So, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}F(3) & =P(X<4) \\  & =P(X\in \{0,1,2,3\}) \\  & =P(X\in \{0,1,2\})+P(X\in \{3\}) \\  & =P(X\le 2)+P(2<X<4) \\  & =F(2)+P(2<X<4).\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}P(2<X<4) & =F(3)-F(2) \\  & =0.2650-0.1247 \\  & =0.1403.\end{aligned}
$$

questions.worked_solution:
The cumulative distribution function of a discrete random variable $X$ is a function $F(x)$ such that

$$
F(x)=P(X\le x).
$$

To solve the given problem, we can use the rule

$$
P(X>a)=1-P(X\le a)=1-F(a).
$$

Now, note that 

$$
P(X\ge 6)=P(X>5).
$$

 

Therefore, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}P(X\ge 6) & =P(X>5) \\  & =1-P(X\le 5) \\  & =1-F(5) \\  & =1-0.7029 \\  & =0.2971.\end{aligned}
$$
